title: Microsoft Teams: Camera view switching in multi-camera Teams Rooms on Windows
description: When in a meeting with another Teams Rooms on Windows that has multiple cameras, you can switch camera views in that room via the participant panel on the console, or video tile on a touch board, to optimize your views.
